Name: Transparent Paths
Author: sweetsakuras
TagLine: Configurable mod that makes paths transparent. Meant to go with automate. AT and CP versions available.
Description:
**Features:**

This mod can make the Gravel, Wood, Crystal, Cobblestone and/or Stepping Stone paths transparent.
All have the option to be turned on or off and can work with other path mods that also have configurable options.

This mod is meant to go with automate so that connector paths can be transparent and not interfere with farm design!
All paths except the Crystal Path are set to "False" by default.

**Changelogs:**

1.1.0
    Added support for winter paths.
1.2.0
    Gravel paths can now have their sound changed.
        They can be set to silent, grass, stone or wood. This requires [Sound Effect Replacement](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10232) in order to work.
1.3.0
    Added an Alternative Textures version. This requires [Alternative Textures](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246) in order to work.
        ONLY USE ONE VERSION OF THIS MOD AT A TIME
1.4.0
    All paths can now have their sound changed.
        NOTE: If you change the wood pathing to sound like stone, everything in the game that uses the wood pathing sound effect will sound like stone, and likewise for all the footstep sound effects. This is a limitation with Content Patcher and I can't do anything about it!
1.5.0
    Removed the option for replacing the sound effects as Sound Effect Replacement is currently broke. Please use [Sounds Patcher](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7465) instead for now.

**Recommended mods:**

[Generic Mod Config Menu](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098) to more easily configure mods from the title screen.
[Ellie's Seasonal Paths and Flooring](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11265) because it's cute and I use it with this mod.
[Sounds Patcher](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7465) to silence sounds.

**Dependencies:**

[Content Patcher](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915)
[Alternative Textures](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246) for the AT version.
    Buy a paint bucket from Robin. Left click on the desired paths with the paint bucket to change its texture.
    *Since this mod makes them transparent, the thumbnail will also be transparent so you'll have to just move your mouse around until you find the transparent texture in the AT menu.
